<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

  <li><strong>Market recovery:</strong> The Sensex and Nifty rebounded with a 315-point gain in the Sensex, driven by value buying and improved sentiment regarding a potential US-Iran deal.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirwFBVV95cUxNT1JFY19ySl9iallxbGNnVzdCMnBXYXZKSjFVbVZ0MHVocTh2NXNmU0ljSXM2TXI5U2JucU92TEhSbHpjVVB5S1ZuYS1FUlFyT0xGb2lPNnBJWUExcHR1TVFjQzFEaEtYM0ZueGRFSmZxUEJSMFBQWXo2bklkTmt4RTM2UDJfbnZVZ05OcnZOckFlM3RnZHJNQU1vZldRN3cweTk3ZkVacTVyak55THFJ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I12</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxQWTBvU0hEcDRONmxadTRfSlBTTEpKM19UM1VqYlhNOGZOLXNCTUVjN0VNeVlSd3VrU01IZnpBSnlVSjFISjk4YUpJT1ZqMml4aWdVaWF1cGxUUUpHSW1LeVI5MU5ESDJyTzNETG1OODdVNFJMc20teHF6dTBEODNxYnZkLWRDcWRnemdLTXhLUVlTUlVqVWJEaUxnWEFsczFJenl4SmZCNDJfemIzRTBqZQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I13</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I22</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I23</a></span></li>
